representation.name: ENCODE ATAC 2.2.3 container probe
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
pwd > probe.txt
printenv PATH >> probe.txt
printf '%s\n' 'java:' >> probe.txt
command -v java >> probe.txt 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'caper:' >> probe.txt
command -v caper >> probe.txt 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'atac.py:' >> probe.txt
command -v atac.py >> probe.txt 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' 'input:' >> probe.txt
ls -l '$(inputs.r1.path)' >> probe.txt
printf '%s\n' 'pipeline candidates:' >> probe.txt
find / -maxdepth 4 \( -name 'atac.wdl' -o -name 'atac.py' -o -name 'cromwell*.jar' -o -name 'caper' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200 >> probe.txt
